subject: Prep TestFlight distribution for family/friends
description: Private invite-only distribution via TestFlight. Steps: (1) Mark enrolls in paid Apple Developer Program ($99/yr — also ends the 7-day re-sign treadmill); (2) strip the embedded health-history.json seeding from shared builds — Mark's personal TRT/weight data currently auto-seeds every fresh install (his own device keeps data via the v4 marker file); (3) blank-slate first-run experience (empty states already mostly exist; verify onboarding makes sense with no data); (4) upload build to App Store Connect / TestFlight, pass beta review; (5) send invites. Notes: builds expire every 90 days (quarterly re-upload); each tester needs their own Gemini key for AI features (everything else works without).
